COUNTCIRCULAREXACTLYONEPAIRTOGETHER.rule: Exactly one of two disjoint specified pairs is adjacent in a rotation-normalized circular arrangement.

COUNTCIRCULARSELECTIONROTATIONONLY.rule: Choose a proper subset of distinct objects and arrange the chosen objects circularly, identifying rotations but not reflections.

COUNTCIRCULARSELECTIONDIHEDRAL.rule: Choose a proper subset of distinct objects and arrange the chosen objects on a reversible ring, identifying both rotations and reflections.

COUNTCIRCULARDISTINCTNEIGHBORSETS.rule: Round-table seatings are equivalent when every person retains the same unordered pair of neighbours, so reversed cycles are identified.
